deadline.value: Materials for Summer and Fall enrollment are due February 15; PhD admission is rolling as funding and advisors allow.
deadline.quote: All application materials must be submitted by February 15 for student enrollment in Summer & Fall semesters

also.quote: the ME department admits Ph.D. students on a rolling basis as funding and advisors become available

app_fee.value: The department lists no application fee.

fee_waiver.value: No application fee, so no waiver is needed.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are optional; the department looks for competitive scores but reviews holistically.
gre_general.quote: looking for applicants with competitive GRE scores (optional)

toefl_min.quote: NOTE: the minimum score requirements for admissions TOEFL – 80 IELTS – 6.5

ielts_min.quote: NOTE: the minimum score requirements for admissions TOEFL – 80 IELTS – 6.5

supervisor.value: Applicants are encouraged to contact ME faculty to identify a research advisor.
supervisor.quote: Thesis master's and Ph.D. students are encouraged to reach out to ME faculty members whose research interests align with their own to identify a research advisor.

funding.value: Fellowships are merit-based, and assistantship funding is driven by faculty research advisors.
funding.quote: Typically, fellowships are awarded on merit.

also.quote: The allocation of assistantship funding is driven primarily by students' faculty research advisors.

entry_route.value: A student with a B.S. but no M.S. may apply directly to the PhD.
